topic: Dashboard filtering and chat integration requirements
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on implementing functionality to simulate activity when filters are applied in the Traffic Dashboard's upper input area. It was decided that a specific endpoint, `/dashboard/traffic/agent/chat`, should be used for this simulation.

Regarding chat integration (the bot opening in the right sidebar), there were discussions about necessary parameters (`params` and `chat_session_id`). The consensus shifted towards ensuring the system could handle both traffic dashboard filters and the dedicated support mode chat environment. It was agreed that the general approach should be to always use `/agent/chat` and pass parameters to it.

Finally, basic functionality for the bot in the right sidebar was deployed to dev, requiring restoration of `session_id` to function correctly.
decisions: Use /dashboard/traffic/agent/chat endpoint to simulate activity when filters are applied on the Traffic Dashboard.
The system should always use /agent/chat and pass parameters to it for consistency.
action_items: Investigate how to handle necessary parameters for both traffic dashboard filtering and right sidebar support chat modes.
Implement a minimal working solution for the bot in the right sidebar, focusing on restoring session ID functionality.
